title: Ruined Speedruning
description: Makes speedrunning a challenge by messing with loot tables and more!
body:
This pack should be played blind, with no knowledge of what the heck is going on, but if you dont care, here you go.
Also don't look at the gallery if you don't want spoilers

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

## Features
- Enderman now drop snowballs named "Ender pearl" instead of ender pearls
- Blazes now drop breeze rods named "Blaze rod" instead of blaze rods
- Beds cannot be placed in the End
- The End fountain is now very tall
- Cod now drop blaze rods
- Horses now drop ender pearls
- The portal room in the stronghold is replaced with parkour upon entering
- Signs that say "Stronghold here" randomely appear on the surface of the overworld
- Iron golems gain speed 10 when aggro
- Shields now cost 1 diamond instead of 1 iron to craft
- Piglin bartering loot table is completely changed

<details>
<summary>Piglin Loot Table</summary>

- Soul Speed Book → Swift Sneak Book (not renamed)
- Iron Boots (Soul Speed) → Copper Boots (Depth Strider), named "Iron Boots"
- Splash Fire Resistance → Splash Poison, named "Splash Potion of Fire Resistance"
- Fire Resistance Potion → Poison Potion, named "Potion of Fire Resistance"
- Water Bottle → Honey Bottle, named "Water Bottle"
- Dried Ghast → Creaking Heart, named "Dried Ghast"
- Iron Nugget (10-36) → Copper Nugget (10-36), named "Iron Nugget"
- Ender Pearl (2-4) → Snowball (2-4), named "Ender Pearl"
- String (3-9) → Iron Chain (3-9), named "String"
- Nether Quartz (5-12) → Bone Meal (5-12), named "Nether Quartz"
- Obsidian (1) → Black Concrete (1), named "Obsidian"
- Crying Obsidian (1-3) → Amethyst Block (1-3), named "Crying Obsidian"
- Fire Charge (1) → Cookie (1), named "Fire Charge"
- Leather (2-4) → Rabbit Hide (2-4), named "Leather"
- Soul Sand (2-8) → Suspicious Sand (2-8), named "Soul Sand"
- Nether Brick (2-8) → Resin Brick (2-8), named "Nether Brick"
- Spectral Arrow (6-12) → Tipped Arrow (Infested) (6-12), named "Spectral Arrow"
- Gravel (8-16) → Pale Oak Leaves (8-16), named "Gravel"
- Blackstone (8-16) → Black Wool (8-16), named "Blackstone"

</details>
